source_datasets.notes: Table P08 reports Muslim, Hindu, Christian, Buddhist, and Others by Total, Male and Female for 64 districts in 8 divisions plus a national row. The sex-classified table excludes the 8,124 hijra (third-gender) persons who are religion-classified only in Table 3.2.15; the district table therefore sums to 165,150,492 rather than the full 165,158,616 population.

indicators.label: Population classified by religion (male + female)
indicators.description: Sum of the five Table P08 religion categories in the district; the sex-classified population.
indicators.method: Sum of the Total columns for Muslim, Hindu, Christian, Buddhist and Others in Table P08.
indicators.quality_notes: The Table P08 basis excludes the 8,124 hijra (third-gender) persons nationally, who are religion-classified only in the division-level Table 3.2.15. There is no not-stated or non-response category.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the classified population reporting one of the five census religion categories.
indicators.method: 100 * (Muslim + Hindu + Christian + Buddhist + Others) / population_total. Every person is classified into a religion category; this therefore equals 100 for every district.
indicators.quality_notes: Bangladesh's census records no no-religion and no not-stated category; affiliation is therefore 100 percent in every district. The per-district composition (Muslim, Hindu, Christian, Buddhist, Others counts) is carried verbatim in each row's quality_flag.

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Unavailable: the BBS census religion frame has no no-religion category.
indicators.method: Not calculated. The frame is Muslim, Hindu, Christian, Buddhist, Others, with no no-religion or not-stated category.
indicators.quality_notes: Rows carry no_religion_category_absent and null no_religion_count/no_religion_percent.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation %
visual_layers.description: Population and Housing Census 2022 religious-affiliation share by district.
visual_layers.notes: No no-religion layer is exposed because the census frame has no no-religion category. Affiliation is 100 percent everywhere; the informative detail is the per-category composition in each row's quality_flag.

rows.population_total_basis: Sum of the five Table P08 religion categories (Muslim, Hindu, Christian, Buddhist, Others), the male + female classified population; excludes hijra (third gender), who are religion-classified only at division level in Table 3.2.15.
